import andes
import numpy as np

ssa = andes.load(
    andes.get_case('ieee14/ieee14_full.xlsx'),
    setup=True,
    no_output=True,
)
ssa.PFlow.run()

bus_ids = ssa.Bus.idx.v
bus_v = ssa.Bus.v.v
slack_v = float(ssa.Slack.v.v[0])

top_indices = np.argsort(bus_v)[-3:][::-1]

print(f"Slack bus voltage: {slack_v:.4f} p.u.")
for rank, idx in enumerate(top_indices, start=1):
    print(f"Top {rank}: Bus {bus_ids[idx]} voltage = {bus_v[idx]:.4f} p.u.")

import andes

v_min = 0.95
v_max = 1.05

ssa = andes.load(
    andes.get_case('kundur/kundur_full.xlsx'),
    setup=False,
    no_output=True,
)
ssa.add('PQ', param_dict=dict(bus=8, idx='PQ_EXTRA_8', p0=0.018, q0=0.01))

    for bus_id, voltage in zip(bus_ids, bus_v)

]

        print(f"Bus {bus_id}: {voltage:.4f} p.u.")

import andes
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ssa = andes.load(
    andes.get_case('ieee14/ieee14_full.xlsx'),
    setup=True,
    no_output=True,
)
ssa.PFlow.run()

bus_ids = [str(bus_id) for bus_id in ssa.Bus.idx.v]
bus_v = ssa.Bus.v.v
